load_json_from_file_object: load a JSON file from a file object and return the parsed Python object
load_json_from_path: load a JSON file from a file path string and return the parsed Python object
dump_json_to_file_object: dump a Python object to a file object as formatted JSON with indented sorted keys
dump_json_to_string: dump a Python object to a JSON-formatted string without indentation
dump_json_to_path: dump a Python object to a file path as formatted JSON with indented sorted keys
